name: synaptic_reality_erosion
label: The Shifting Ground of Self
godotFeature: Godot 4.6.2 Physics Engine (dynamic collision shapes, RigidBody), GDScript for real-time mesh manipulation (MeshDataTool or ArrayMesh), and custom shaders for visual decay.
poeticVision: The player feels the crushing dread of their own self-dissolution manifesting as the very ground beneath their feet crumbling into nothingness. Every precarious jump, every collapsing path is a tangible representation of their internal struggle against forgetting, forcing split-second decisions not just against external threats but against the treacherous landscape of their own mind. It's a desperate race against the world turning against itself, reflecting Lyra's vanishing identity.

parameters.name: identity_integrity
parameters.description: Represents the platform's current integrity. 1.0 is fully solid, 0.0 is fully eroded. This value will decrease over time if not reinforced.

parameters.name: erosion_rate
parameters.description: The rate at which 'identity_integrity' decreases per second when not reinforced. Higher values mean faster erosion.

parameters.name: reinforce_duration
parameters.description: The duration (in seconds) for which the platform remains fully solid after being reinforced by a memory shard.

parameters.name: max_erosion_shrink_factor
parameters.description: The maximum factor by which the collision shape's extents will shrink when fully eroded (0.0 = no shrink, 1.0 = full shrink). Visual fading is always 100%.

verdict: The ground beneath Lyra's feet becomes a cruel mirror, reflecting the terrifying fragility of her own fading self.
impact: This mechanic will immerse the player in Lyra's internal struggle, making the very environment a tangible representation of her dissolving identity. Every step becomes a precarious decision, forcing players to confront the immediate physical threat of a crumbling world while simultaneously feeling the existential dread of self-loss. It transforms platforming from a mere traversal challenge into a constant, urgent battle against forgetting, demanding split-second reactions and strategic resource management to literally hold the world, and Lyra's self, together.
